step-1.text: Stand one side panel on its edge, holes facing in. Butt the bottom board against it and drive two screws through the side into the board. Stop when the head is flush.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 1 top and bottom and 2 screws.

step-2.text: Screw the long shelf to the same side, two screws each. The holes set the cubby height, so just follow them.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 long shelf and 2 screws.

step-3.text: Tap a dowel into each divider hole, then press the eight short dividers in between the boards, four per row. Push each one fully home so the cubbies stay square.

count-3.text: This step uses 8 dividers and 8 wood dowels.

step-4.text: Set the top board over the last row of dividers and screw it to the side panel.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 top and bottom and 2 screws.

step-5.text: With a helper steadying it, line the second side up with every board end and screw it on, top to bottom. Then check each cubby is square before the screws bite.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 side panel and 6 screws.

step-6.text: Set it on a flat floor and press on each top corner. If it rocks, check the screws again. Fill the low cubbies with the heavy things.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your SLEEKLINE 10-cubby storage 2×5 is built. Give it a proud little pat.
